summary: Two FAILs. The critical one is A.no-uncaptioned-images: at least 6 of 17 work images have captions that do not match the visible image content. The scraper appears to have cross-contaminated project image batches when pulling from the Mouthwash Sanity CDN: Air Company images appear under The North Face and Seed captions; a Barcelona architecture firm (Mesura) and a clothing brand (Literary Sport) appear under The North Face and Fender captions respectively; a Perron Roettinger studio page appears under Air Company. This is a data integrity failure that would send Jonathan misleading information about her work. The secondary fail is D.provenance-written: source_url is null for all 15 provenance fields. The entry has real strengths: writing bookmarks are well-chosen and substantive (Substack, Mr Porter, chapbook), context shots are verified correct, metadata is solid, and AI Notes are appropriately hedged. Fix the image caption corruption and add source URLs to provenance, then resubmit.
